author: ComradeCactus
description: Work in progress. A stock market simulator that uses tots and real stock prices fetched from RapidAPI. Currently only supports fetching quotes.
install_msg: This cog is unfinished. Use `[p]stonksetup setrapidapi` to set your RapidAPI host and key, then `[p]stonks quote <ticker>` to get a quote.
short: Stock market simulator using tots and real prices (WIP)
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not currently persistently store end user data.
